Discover
The Residences

Where Luxury Meets
Everyday Living

Royal Crest is an insightfully planned architectural development offering luxurious 3 BHK residential spaces. Strategically located at Appa Junction, the building rises brilliantly across 5 floors with 10 meticulously crafted homes.

Each residence has been designed with an array of premium finishes and amenities. Whichever flat you choose, you will be greeted by abundant natural light and breeze throughout the day.

Built in collaboration with Royal Constructions — using superior materials, diligent planning and branded fixtures — every detail speaks to a safe, secure, and refined environment for your family.

Superior structural integrity, built to last
